label: Every held stock
holds: every US stock in any manager's book, equal-weighted

label: Best ideas (#1)
holds: each manager's largest position, weighted by how many managers name it

label: Top-3 positions
holds: each manager's three largest positions, pair-weighted

label: Most crowded
holds: top quintile of held stocks by number of managers holding

label: Least crowded
holds: bottom quintile — held by a single manager, smallest dollar stake

label: New positions
holds: stocks a manager bought this quarter that it did not hold last quarter

label: Added to
holds: positions where shares rose ≥ 25% vs last quarter

label: Trimmed
holds: positions where shares fell ≥ 25% but are still held

label: Sold out
holds: stocks a manager held last quarter and no longer holds

label: US market
holds: Ken French total US market (CRSP value-weighted)
